bio: Gaytán is the culmination of a dream which then became a reality for chef Javier Aranda and as a result is far from your usual type of restaurant. This space, which features an interior with many design details and two private lounges, is dominated by original wooden columns that flank the large open kitchen overlooking the dining room, so that guests feel as though they are part of the creative process.
